Initial release of **Spotty** — a keyboard-driven terminal UI for Spotify, built with Rust.

## Downloads

| Platform | Binary | Checksum |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Linux (x86_64) | `spotty-linux-x86_64.tar.gz` | `spotty-linux-x86_64.tar.gz.sha256` |
| macOS (Apple Silicon) | `spotty-macos-aarch64.tar.gz` | `spotty-macos-aarch64.tar.gz.sha256` |
| macOS (Intel) | `spotty-macos-x86_64.tar.gz` | `spotty-macos-x86_64.tar.gz.sha256` |
| Windows (x86_64) | `spotty-windows-x86_64.exe.zip` | `spotty-windows-x86_64.exe.zip.sha256` |

See the [README](https://github.com/vquclinh/spotty#installation) for installation instructions.
